name: rules
description: RULE concepts with useful limits and complications

fields.Name: Thread RULE
fields.Description: Create and control a few meters of thread within sight; stronger fibers require carried material, and control weakens sharply with distance.

fields.Name: Echo RULE
fields.Description: Capture one sound and replay or redirect it; loud sounds cost more AP and only one captured sound can be held at a time.

fields.Name: Rust RULE
fields.Description: Accelerate corrosion on touched non-magical metal; large or well-maintained objects require sustained contact.

fields.Name: Door RULE
fields.Description: Sense and manipulate ordinary doors nearby; cannot create passages or affect a threshold the user cannot clearly imagine.

fields.Name: Ink RULE
fields.Description: Animate written ink into moving symbols and simple shapes; destroying the source writing ends the effect.

fields.Name: Mist RULE
fields.Description: Produce and shape cool fog nearby; wind disperses it and the user cannot see through it naturally.

fields.Name: Borrowed Face RULE
fields.Description: Copy the face of someone touched for one hour; voice, clothing, memories, and mannerisms remain unchanged.

fields.Name: Glass RULE
fields.Description: Bend and reshape touched glass without heat; shattered fragments remain dangerous and mass cannot be created.

fields.Name: Promise RULE
fields.Description: Sense when a willingly spoken promise is broken; cannot force honesty or determine why it was broken.

fields.Name: Friction RULE
fields.Description: Increase or decrease friction across a small visible surface; extremes are brief and affect allies as readily as enemies.

fields.Name: Scent RULE
fields.Description: Create, remove, and follow mundane scents; complex copied scents require a sample.

fields.Name: Paper RULE
fields.Description: Fold paper into briefly animated tools or creatures; water, fire, and heavy force destroy them easily.

fields.Name: Salt RULE
fields.Description: Create and shape a handful of salt; larger quantities cause exhaustion, and summoned salt dissolves by sunrise.

fields.Name: Heartbeat RULE
fields.Description: Sense nearby heartbeats and briefly synchronize with one; constructs and many undead are invisible to it.

fields.Name: Color RULE
fields.Description: Move or alter color on visible surfaces; effects are cosmetic but can enable camouflage or coded signals.

fields.Name: Balance RULE
fields.Description: Stabilize a touched object or willing person against ordinary motion; sudden heavy force can overwhelm it.

fields.Name: Threshold RULE
fields.Description: Know when a designated boundary is crossed; only one boundary can be watched and it must be physically marked.

fields.Name: Swarm RULE
fields.Description: Communicate simple intentions to a small group of mundane insects; it grants no direct control over unnatural creatures.

fields.Name: Chance RULE
fields.Description: Once per scene, nudge a trivial random outcome; the GM chooses an equally unlikely inconvenience that follows.

fields.Name: Impact RULE
fields.Description: Briefly amplifies a charge, strike, or projectile; it cannot change the trajectory and transfers some recoil to the user.

fields.Name: Ricochet RULE
fields.Description: Deflects a projectile toward a second visible surface; every bounce sharply reduces power and requires a plausible angle.

fields.Name: Celerity RULE
fields.Description: Accelerates one simple movement for a few seconds; the user’s decisions and perceptions do not speed up.

fields.Name: Invisibility RULE
fields.Description: Visually conceals a motionless target; sound, tracks, and moved objects remain perceptible.

fields.Name: Flame RULE
fields.Description: Creates or directs nearby fire; its size depends on available fuel and it remains dangerous to allies.

fields.Name: Frost RULE
fields.Description: Rapidly removes heat from a small surface; it can form ice but cannot instantly freeze a whole creature.

fields.Name: Rain RULE
fields.Description: Condenses humidity into local rain; the effect is weak in a very dry environment.

fields.Name: Healing RULE
fields.Description: Accelerates closure of a recent wound; it replaces neither lost blood nor a destroyed limb.

fields.Name: Teleportation RULE
fields.Description: Moves the user to a visible clear point; it fails when the route crosses consecrated protection.

fields.Name: Electricity RULE
fields.Description: Produces or guides a discharge between conductors; the user must control the current’s path.

fields.Name: Storm RULE
fields.Description: Strengthens existing weather; it cannot create a full storm beneath a perfectly calm sky.

fields.Name: Blessing RULE
fields.Description: Grants a limited advantage to an action following a declared vow; breaking the vow immediately ends the effect.

fields.Name: Summoning RULE
fields.Description: Calls a minor entity matching a prepared symbol; it keeps its will and demands a reasonable price.

fields.Name: Resurrection RULE
fields.Description: Briefly recalls a recently dead spirit into its body; each use exacts a lasting cost and the spirit may refuse.

fields.Name: Curse RULE
fields.Description: Binds a precise penalty to a clearly stated condition; the target must be able to understand how to break it.

fields.Name: Vampirism RULE
fields.Description: Transfers a small amount of vitality through contact; it cannot exceed the injuries actually inflicted.

fields.Name: Telekinesis RULE
fields.Description: Moves a visible object at range; mass and precision cannot both be maximized.

fields.Name: Influence RULE
fields.Description: Strengthens an already plausible emotion or suggestion; it creates neither lasting loyalty nor action against core values.

fields.Name: Dead RULE
fields.Description: Gives one simple order to an animated corpse; it regains neither complete memories nor lost intelligence.

fields.Name: Illusion RULE
fields.Description: Produces a credible image or sound in a limited area; it has no mass or heat of its own.

fields.Name: Sleep RULE
fields.Description: Deepens the fatigue of a calm target; pain or immediate danger can wake them.

fields.Name: Soul Bond RULE
fields.Description: Lets two volunteers share a sensation or emotion; great distance blurs the bond.

fields.Name: Ghost RULE
fields.Description: Briefly makes part of the body intangible; the effect cannot be maintained while carrying a heavy load.

fields.Name: Spirits RULE
fields.Description: Manifests a protective or vengeful spirit tied to a memory; it follows that memory rather than exact orders.

fields.Name: Familiar RULE
fields.Description: Creates a sensory bond with a consenting small animal; confusion and pain cross both ways.

fields.Name: Plants RULE
fields.Description: Accelerates or guides plant growth; it requires water, nutrients, and a still-living plant.

fields.Name: Beasts RULE
fields.Description: Conveys a simple intention to an animal; it removes neither fear nor instinct.

fields.Name: Spores RULE
fields.Description: Produces toxic, soothing, or curative spores; only one effect may be prepared and wind remains uncontrolled.

fields.Name: Stone RULE
fields.Description: Moves or shapes a limited amount of rock; complex structures take time and knowledge of their load.

fields.Name: Petrification RULE
fields.Description: Gradually turns a small exposed area to stone; complete transformation needs repeated applications and is reversible at first.

fields.Name: Decay RULE
fields.Description: Accelerates deterioration of dead matter; treated or protected materials decay slowly.

fields.Name: Gravity RULE
fields.Description: Raises or lowers apparent weight in a small area; inertia and structural strength do not change.

fields.Name: Magnetism RULE
fields.Description: Attracts or repels nearby metals; nonmetallic objects and rare alloys react weakly.

fields.Name: Double RULE
fields.Description: Creates a temporary imperfect copy of the user; it shares intentions but not recent memories.

fields.Name: Time RULE
fields.Description: Slightly accelerates or slows a local process; it cannot rewrite the past or undo a decision.

fields.Name: Space RULE
fields.Description: Opens a brief passage between prepared surfaces; the same user must have marked both points.

fields.Name: Vision RULE
fields.Description: Shows one possible future consequence of an immediate decision; changed circumstances invalidate it.

fields.Name: Size RULE
fields.Description: Temporarily enlarges or shrinks an object or creature; unstable mass sharply limits duration.

fields.Name: Wind RULE
fields.Description: Directs an air current or creates a gust; the effect quickly weakens in a very large space.

fields.Name: Blood RULE
fields.Description: Tracks or identifies someone from their blood; the sample is consumed and may be contaminated.

fields.Name: Shadow RULE
fields.Description: Thickens or moves an existing shadow; intense light reduces its reach and solidity.

fields.Name: Sand RULE
fields.Description: Moves and compacts sand or dust; it creates no matter and becomes imprecise in rain.

fields.Name: Metal RULE
fields.Description: Bends or joins a small amount of heated metal; enchanted alloys resist the effect.

fields.Name: Mirror RULE
fields.Description: Copies the visible appearance of an observed RULE without its full power; only one imitation may be retained.

fields.Name: Memory RULE
fields.Description: Clarifies or blurs a memory; it cannot invent missing information and leaves detectable traces.
